name: rbp19b-guard2-both-readings-22-prompts
what_this_is: Spec §3.3 step 3, guard 2 over the shipped 12-point perturbation family and all 22 frozen task prompts, under BOTH readings of 'a word the point adds or removes'. The user's ruling (2026-08-12) is that both are computed, both are reported, and NEITHER is wrong. This file supersedes any earlier artifact that labels one of them 'the corrected table'.
retraction: docs/eval-data/2026-08-12-nonfragile-anchor-set.json's `guard_note` and per-cell notes called the substitution-pair set 'the CORRECTED violation set' and said M1's screen 'under-reported P2-asks-requests'. Both phrases are RETRACTED. Commit 25ce48b's message and 9ca1576's 'their wrong P2 row' stand in git history as written and are wrong on this point; git history is not rewritten. AMENDED 2026-08-12 (this field only; no table in this file changed): this field previously read “That file is committed evidence and is not retro-edited; this file and docs/eval.md's RB-P19 entry carry the correction.” That is no longer true and would misdirect a reader. On the user's ruling of 2026-08-12 the anchor set's `guard_note`, its three per-cell notes and its `how_to_use` were amended IN PLACE, with a visible `amended` block, because the invariant protects measurements from being refitted to conclusions and not a prose annotation that has become a live misdirection in the file operators actually open. Every measured field in that file is byte-identical to b439053. The correction is carried in three places now: that file's `amended` block, this file, and docs/eval.md's RB-P19 entry.

readings.whole-text: symmetric difference of the base and perturbed TEMPLATE word sets — §3.3's operative Test sentence, and what an independent re-derivation from the spec produced
readings.substitution-pair: symmetric difference of the point's own `from`/`to` word sets — what §3.3 step 4's substitution-pair form and the manifest's P2 justification imply

decision_rule: union — a (point, cell) is tainted if EITHER reading flags it, because under-detection is the direction this guard exists to prevent
tokenizer: A hyphen is a word boundary. Before 2026-08-12 it was word-internal, so `requests-per-minute` was one token and `requests` was invisible to BOTH readings — a false negative. Fixed; this table is post-fix.
